profile.ja: 単独での危険な潜入任務を主とする手練の対魔忍。才色兼備の女性で６ヶ国語に通じ、２つの博士号と数十に渡る分野の専門知識を有し、あらゆる経歴の人物となって潜入可能で高度な隠密技術の持ち主。戦闘能力も高く忍法・木遁の術の使い手。通称“花の静流”。植物を操り、特定の武器は持たず戦闘時は掌から強力な薔薇の鞭を出現させ操って戦う。物腰軽やかな大人の女性。妖艶な魅力で男性を魅了するのも潜入任務では欠かせない才能の一つ。
profile.en: Kousaka Shizuru is a seasoned Taimanin who specializes in dangerous solo infiltration missions. A talented and beautiful woman fluent in six languages, she holds two doctorates and possesses expert knowledge across dozens of fields, allowing her to assume any background and infiltrate with advanced stealth techniques. Her combat abilities are also high; she wields ninjutsu and wood-style techniques. Known as "Shizuru of the Flowers," she manipulates plants and, without carrying weapons, summons a powerful rose-whip from her palm to fight. She carries herself with a light, adult grace, and her seductive charm is an essential asset for infiltration, effortlessly captivating men.

text.ja: 「対魔忍、高坂静流よ。花の静流とも呼ばれているわ、よろしくね♪」
text.en: "Taimanin, Kousaka Shizuru here. I'm also called the Flower Shizuru, nice to meet you♪"

text.ja: ふふふ、のんびりしている様に見えるけど大丈夫なのかしら？
text.en: "Hehe, you look all relaxed, but are you really okay?"

text.ja: あまり女性をジロジロ見る物じゃないわよ。まあ、私はなれているけど♪
text.en: "Don't be staring at women all the time. Well, I'm used to it though♪"

text.ja: そんなに緊張しなくて良いのよ、何かあったら助けてあげるわ♪
text.en: "You don't have to be so nervous; I'll help you out if anything comes up♪"

text.ja: ん～……最近デスクワークが多くてちょっと身体が鈍り気味ね
text.en: "Hmm… I've been doing a lot of desk work lately, so my body feels a bit sluggish."

text.ja: 花と呼ばれて嫌がる女はいないわ。でも、綺麗な花には棘があるものよ♪
text.en: "No woman hates being called a flower. But beautiful flowers do have thorns, you know♪"

text.ja: 私は“花の静流”植物ならなんでも意のままに操ることからそう呼ばれているの
text.en: "I'm called 'Flower Shizuru' because I can control any plant at will."

text.ja: 元気な男の子は嫌いじゃないけれど、あまりイタズラが過ぎるようなら……ふふふ♪
text.en: "I don't mind energetic boys, but if they get too mischievous… hehe♪"
